verdict.rationale: Google Voice's admin docs say organizations can deploy and manage phone numbers, that a Voice admin can provision numbers, and that employees get a phone number. That is first-party number provisioning, but only at a glancing level: nothing shows searching available inventory by area code or how fast purchase and activation happen. Porting existing numbers is a different capability and earns no credit here. missing for 10: search of available numbers by area code, a documented local-number purchase flow, evidence it completes in minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes
